chiplets_assessment: The chiplet leaf fits this stack when the register trace and the four chips are one Relation under one vk_U. midnight-proofs 0.8.3 supplies lookup, lookup_any and permutation inside a single ConstraintSystem; it has no LogUp API, so the bus closes inside the leaf and later leaves link only by register and root commitments. A separate proof per chip would add a combiner that verifies those proofs, which is the cost the node budget does not have: two self-verifications are already 730,243 rows. Poseidon here is 18 round rows per permutation after five-round skips, so hashing belongs in a chip, and the 73-row compression figure should be discarded. Chips stay out of vk_N so the self-verifier and the 929,166-row decider keep the thin BLS12-381 plus Poseidon shape; genesis is a fixed Init check on the first leaf because the roots start empty.
proposed_requirement_text: When h_pre = 0, the universal leaf SHALL constrain its pre-state register file and its program, memory and stack roots to Init(prog_d, input_d). input_d SHALL commit the run input, the initial fuel as a u128 and the stack limit. When a segment is sealed, the sealing circuit SHALL require h_lo = 0 and an outcome of Halted, Rejected or Exhausted. Equality with a supplied init_d alone SHALL NOT satisfy this requirement.

The universal leaf U SHALL have one fixed verifying key over a fixed register file and the rule inventory. It SHALL prove between 1 and S owner steps, where S is the largest of 16, 8 and 4 for which the measured leaf fits k <= 19. Program reads, memory, 128-bit arithmetic and Poseidon SHALL be chips inside that same circuit, joined by the library lookup and permutation arguments, which SHALL close inside the leaf. The memory chip SHALL enforce operation conservation, ordering, initialization and read-after-write, and the published roots SHALL match the net writes. State that crosses a leaf boundary SHALL be the register digest and the program and memory roots.

The node N SHALL verify two proofs under one shared constraint-system shape and SHALL, in the same circuit, bind the composition shape, seal a completed segment, discharge dependencies and union claim sets. That predicate is the new work required beside the two proofs. A VM segment SHALL enter as a run-lift proof and a foreign proof SHALL enter as a foreign-lift proof.

When a foreign proof is admitted, the registry SHALL bind its verifier class: constraint-system shape, k, exact public-input count, transcript and SRS identity. An adapter key for that class SHALL be registry data, and admitting one SHALL NOT change the core key set {U, R, F, N, C, D}. The foreign lift SHALL fold the adapter's inner accumulator only when the foreign proof uses the outer SRS; otherwise the adapter SHALL check the pairing and publish no inner accumulator.

When a claim states that ledger-format Compact proof bytes were verified, the adapter SHALL enforce the incremental Blake2b transcript of hash length 64, keyed with the transcript domain separator, including its absorb and squeeze prefixes, complete consumption of the proof bytes, canonical scalar bounds and prime-subgroup checks on received points. A re-proof under a Poseidon transcript SHALL NOT satisfy that claim.

Program and memory commitments SHALL use an active Merkle depth from 1 to 64 under the single leaf key. When allocation grows past the active depth, the leaf SHALL extend the root by one in-circuit compression and increment the depth. A change of program size, value size, call depth or helper depth SHALL NOT require a new key.
